DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 86 s. 2022 SEP 12 2022 ENGR. SAMUEL SIDDAYAO Municipal Mayor Gattaran, Province of Cagayan Centro Sur, Gattaran, Cagayan Dear Mayor Siddayao: This has reference to your letter dated 01 August 2022 addressed to Provincial Director Engr. Elma M. Urbina, DILG-Cagayan, wherein you are seeking an opinion or recommendation regarding the suspension of Peryahan ng Bayan Games. At the outset, we are aware that in the subject letter of Atty. Bernard D. Vitriolo, Vice President for Legal of Globaltech Mobile Online Corp. (Globaltech), he maintains that the letter sent to this Department by Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) General Manager, Royin Garma, against the lawful operation of the Peryahan ng Bayan Games of Globaltech is misleading and erroneous, contending that the application of the PCSO Suspension Order dated 05 February 2020 pursuant to the 29 January 2020 Memorandum from the Office of the President must yield to the Final and Executory Decision of the Court of Appeals dated 14 January 2019 affirming the Status Quo Ante Order dated 17 May 2016. Due to the fact that the legal dispute between PCSO and Globaltech has been submitted for arbitration, we regret to inform you that we can no longer act on your request for legal opinion as we are proscribed to act on those that are already litis pendentia or pending litigation as well as those matters cognizable by other agencies of the government. However, it may be well to stress that on 26 July 2019, then President Rodrigo Duterte suspended the gaming operations of the PCSO. Accordingly, on 05 February 2020, PCSO, through its General Manager Royina Marza Garma, suspended the operation of Peryahan Games, effective 06 February 2020 until further notice from the Office of the President, citing the Memorandum dated January 29, 2020, issued by then Executive Secretary Salvador Medialdea to PCSO, wherein it provides that the resumption of Peryahan Games operation are still suspended. In compliance therewith, this Department, in an Advisory dated 19 June 2020, disseminated information to all concerned officials and the public, regarding the advice of the PCSO to temporarily suspend the nationwide PCSO Lottery and other on line- gaming activities, such as, Digit Games, Keno, Small-Town Lotter, and Instant Sweepstakes (Scratch It), until further notice. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

The act of the President of suspending the gaming operations of the PCSO was made to promote general welfare and public interest due to reports of rampant corruption in the PCSO. The President has the obligation under the Constitution to protect the people, promote their welfare and advance the national interest pursuant to his residual power to protect the general welfare of the people. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: AN Undersec ary for Local Government OSEC/EMNLLLS-LRALLD/rjki/clp COPY FURNISHED: JONATHAN PAUL M.
